channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mexico City | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mexico City from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jaime Jaquez on Mexico City
item.description:
“The fans had a great time and really embraced us and the NBA.I definitely think it’d be a great location if the league wants to expand. It’s a beautiful city with a lot to do down there. I think it only makes sense — there’s already a team in Canada, so to have one down in Mexico would be great.”

Jaime Jaquez on Mexico City, Oct 31, 2025. Source: Responsible Gaming.

item.title: Adam Silver on Mexico City
item.description:
“But at the same time, once we move into expansion mode and start looking at all the considerations that go with expansion, I think that would then allow us to have more of a template to understand whether a city like Mexico City would be suitable.”

Adam Silver on Mexico City, Nov 4, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Adam Silver on Mexico City
item.description:
When asked about bringing the NBA All-Star Game to Mexico City, Silver suggested the city would be a top choice if the league held the event outside the U.S. and Canada.

“There’s a long list of NBA cities that are also competing to get All-Star Games, butI think if we were to bring an All-Star Game, again, outside of our U.S. cities or, of course, Toronto, Mexico City would be at the top of our list,”

Adam Silver on Mexico City, Nov 4, 2024. Source: Dallas Hoops Journal.

item.title: Jaime Jaquez on Mexico City
item.description:
“I’ve got a lot of family that’s in Mexico that’s going to come, as well as my family from California that’s going to come down to watch,”

Jaime Jaquez on Mexico City, Nov 1, 2024. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Jamahl Mosley on Mexico City
item.description:
The Magic will play their third regular-season game in Mexico City, and the Hawks will make their debut south of the border.

“I'm so excited for our guys that they're going to be able to go to Mexico City and feel that atmosphere, that passion for the game and it brings people together,”

Jamahl Mosley on Mexico City, Nov 8, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kenneth Faried on Mexico City
item.description:
Kenneth Faried:

“Hopefully being in this great city of Mexico City and being on this team, Capitanes, the experience and the minutes I’ve been getting, I can continue to showcase to the NBA that I’m ready for whatever team wants to hopefully pick me up. Like I said, I’m ready, I’m focused, I’m locked in, I’m a better vet, a better person, a better leader and I don’t even need to be a leader. I can be quiet and sit back and just follow whoever the leader is.”

Kenneth Faried on Mexico City, Jan 24, 2023. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Junior Bridgeman on Mexico City
item.description:
“They responded that they were not looking at expansion, but if they would, the top two cities would be Seattle and Mexico City. I have not heard anything since then.”

Junior Bridgeman on Mexico City, Oct 22, 2020. Source: Louisville Courier-Journal.
